notes.title: Opening of the Hall of Fame Update
notes.notes:
[p]Brave Ones![/p][p]The world of Singoru never stands still! On the horizon are new challenges, fresh opportunities, and even more reasons to prove yourself. And the greatest of these will be the opening of the [b]Hall of Fame[/b] — a place where only the best of the best will remain. It is time to see what has changed in Singoru — we are sure that each of you will find something for yourself![/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Building: Hall of Fame[/h3][p]A historic event has taken place in our town!
The [b]Hall of Fame[/b] has been solemnly opened — a place where the names of the greatest Braves are immortalized. Now you can prove to everyone that your name shines brighter than all among the legends![/p][p]The Hall of Fame takes into account much more than just profile level. The ranking system reflects everything that makes a player a true legend: player progress, victories over bosses, portal discoveries, and acquired equipment. To have your name appear in the Hall of Fame, it is enough to log in after the update — because only the achievements of active players are counted.[/p][p]As we mentioned earlier in our diaries, over time the Hall of Fame will develop, gain new features, and become more and more interesting. Ahead await seasons and leagues, new stages, and of course, rewards. For being in the lead is already an achievement, and receiving a worthy reward for it is doubly pleasant.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Hall of Fame Rankings[/h3][p][b]Masters of Progress — Profile Level[/b]
The higher your current profile level, the higher your position in the overall list. The metric is simple and clear: as the profile level grows, the place in the Hall of Fame also rises.[/p][p][b]Titan Hunters — Boss Kills[/b]
Glory points are awarded for victories over bosses and scale based on:[/p][list][*][p]the difficulty of the location (the harder the location, the more points);[/p][/*][*][p]the order of the boss in the location (defeating the final boss gives more points than the first).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Lords of Aether — Portal Discoveries[/b]
Ranking for opening aether portals:[/p][list][*][p]points are awarded for opening portals;[/p][/*][*][p]time-limited portals, opened with Prisms of Eternity, bring more ranking points.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Forges of Fate — Equipment Acquisition[/b]
Points are awarded for obtaining equipment items from various sources:[/p][list][*][p]the higher the rarity and star rating of the item, the more points you receive;[/p][/*][*][p]the method of obtaining equipment also affects the number of points.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Clans[/b]
A separate section has already been reserved and will appear in future updates.[/p][p]⚠️ Important: Titan Hunter and Lord of Aether rankings will not take into account past merits in the world of Singoru.[/p][p]For all Braves the conditions will be equal: no one will gain an advantage from old merits, and the final place in the ranking will depend only on your actions after the opening of the Hall of Fame.
Now everything is in your hands — prove your mastery and earn the right to be called the best Titan Hunter or try on the crown of the Lord of Aether![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Adjustments to Unholy Barrier and Throwing Disk Evolutions[/h3][p]An error was discovered in which modifiers from passive abilities were not applied to the evolutions [b]“You Shall Not Pass!”[/b] and [b]“Queen’s Song”[/b] if the player learned these passive abilities after obtaining the evolutions themselves.[/p][p]Now the system works correctly:[/p][list][*][p]If the evolution was obtained earlier and the passive ability that affects this evolution was learned later, the modifiers will still be applied. The evolutions [b]“You Shall Not Pass!”[/b] and [b]“Queen’s Song”[/b] will receive bonuses to damage, area of effect, projectile speed, and so on.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Simplification of Early Stages of the Game[/h3][p]Health and Attack values of monsters have been reduced in several Normal mode locations:[/p][list][*][p]Forest (from Easy to Hell difficulties),[/p][/*][*][p]Laboratory (from Easy to Hell difficulties),[/p][/*][*][p]Graveyard (from Easy to Hard difficulties),[/p][/*][*][p]Mycelium (Easy difficulty).[/p][/*][/list][p]The frequency of receiving touch damage from monsters has been reduced by 2 times.[/p][p]These changes are aimed at making the early stage of the game more comfortable for new players and speeding up progress in the first locations. Now the first steps in Singoru will become easier, and mastering the basic mechanics more comfortable.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Hero Rebalance[/h3][p][b]Clara[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Added a new specialization that allows, upon a successful dodge, to increase the hero’s movement speed by 30% for 1 second.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Mysterious Code[/b][/h3][p]In honor of the release of the update, we are giving you a mysterious code: [b]HALLOFFAME[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ac8bd3548349f6206a91d611421d16d3c8964c7f.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]That is all for now, Brave Ones. We hope that you will appreciate the new features! Stay with us, share your impressions of the game — we are always happy to hear feedback and make the game even better![/p][p]Success to you on your path to glory — and may the Hall of Fame preserve the memory of your victories![/p]

But that’s not all. While you’re exploring the updated base screen, brave heroes have already set out to scout the lands surrounding the city. notes.title: The "Era of Stars" update
notes.notes:
[p]Brave ones![/p][p]We are pleased to present to you the new major update for The Braves! We have a lot of news, big and small, so let’s not waste any time and dive straight into what awaits you![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Star Coins Drop[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b]Brave ones, the moment has come to test your valor![/p][p]Starting today, Star Coins have become the official reward for defeating bosses in Hardcore mode! But that’s just the beginning — soon this rare currency will become part of another unique mode. Stay tuned for updates!  Show what you're capable of — challenge the strongest opponents, face the harshest trials, and earn this truly rare currency, which will find wide use across the Singoru realms![/p][p]Let the stars witness your feats![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Armor: Star Fortress Set[/b][/h2][p]Since the Ether began calling heroes, the world has changed. Not suddenly — more like someone started a long-forgotten mechanism. The gears of fate, resting for centuries, have begun to turn again.  Strange creatures appeared, unstable portals opened, mysterious artifacts and enigmatic coins were discovered. They were called Star Coins — for their shimmering light and the feeling that each one contains a fragment of something distant and powerful.  The material of these coins turned out to be unusual. It was melted down, studied, and combined with other metals. Thus, the Star Fortress Set was born — a full set of armor created for those who face death without flinching.  What advantages does the Star Fortress Set offer, you ask? Let’s break it down:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Star Fortress Armor [/b] [/h3][list][*][p]+6% health at uncommon rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+16% health at rare rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]Reduces incoming damage by +10% at epic rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+32% chance for experience drop from enemies at legendary rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+0.28% armor for each percentage of missing health at mythical rarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Star Fortress Helmet[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b] [/b] +6% health at uncommon rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+16% health at rare rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]-9.9% cooldown time for abilities at epic rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+7 seconds to invulnerability duration after resurrection at legendary rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+20% experience gained at mythical rarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Star Fortress Boots [/b] [/h3][list][*][p]+6% health at uncommon rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+16% health at rare rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+11% projectile speed at epic rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+7.7% movement speed at legendary rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+3% health per passive skill at mythical rarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Star Fortress Gloves [/b] [/h3][list][*][p]+6% attack at uncommon rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+15% attack at rare rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+5.5% skill range at epic rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+4% damage per evolution of active skill at legendary rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]30% chance of double damage for all evolutions at mythical rarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Star Fortress Ring [/b] [/h3][list][*][p]+6% attack at uncommon rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+15% attack at rare rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]Additional skill restrictions in the match: 4 at epic rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]10% chance to restore 10% health upon taking damage at legendary rarity [/p][/*][*][p] +1 passive skill slot at mythical rarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Full Set Bonus [/b] [/h3][list][*][p]+2 Resurrections[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5c03222ae7bdbd931d1115b68c7c0bedd030c9ce.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Attention! This set is only available in the "Equipment" tab in the Market building and can be purchased with Star Coins.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]More Control in Battle[/b][/h2][p]Braves, meet one of the most useful combat interface improvements!  No more guessing and missed rotations — each active unique ability is now accompanied by a clear timer showing exactly how many seconds are left before the next use.[/p][p]Even if you're just starting your journey in The Braves, the updated interface will help you get up to speed with battle mechanics faster. And if you're a veteran — your tactical play will become even more precise and confident.  Forward, Braves! Your abilities are now fully under control![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Rebalancing Frost Shards[/b][/h2][p]We closely monitor how abilities perform in battle and listen to your feedback. Thanks to this, one of the old abilities has been reworked, retaining its core concept but gaining new, more efficient mechanics. We are talking about the Frost Shards and their evolution — Explosive Shards.[/p][p]Previously, the shards always fired straight behind the character in a straight line. Now, they home in on the nearest enemies behind you, prioritizing those closest to the character. If there are several targets behind you, the Frost Shards will be evenly distributed among them when the ability is activated.[/p][p]These changes also apply to Explosive Shards.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notifications[/b][/h2][p]You asked — we added it!  Now, all important updates are marked with notifications — those little red dots that appear on buttons, tabs, and icons when:[/p][list][*][p]You receive a new piece of equipment or hero[/p][/*][*][p]You have enough shards to upgrade a hero's rarity[/p][/*][*][p]New slots open in the market or bank[/p][/*][*][p]New features or important events appear  [/p][/*][/list][p]With them, it’s easier: you don’t need to search for anything — the game will guide you on where to look.  Navigation has become faster, and gameplay even more convenient![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Academy Branch: Summoning[/b][/h2][p]The Academy continues to develop, and now there is a new branch of study — specifically for summoner heroes!  The Summoning branch opens up unique abilities that strengthen summoned minions in battle.[/p][p]Several heroes have reconsidered their paths and switched their specialization. Now their primary focus will be Summoning, rather than Attack, Defense, or Support, as it was before.[/p][p]We present to you a list of these heroes:[/p][list][*][p]Terra[/p][/*][*][p]Sylpha[/p][/*][*][p]Calizk[/p][/*][*][p]Jabir [/p][/*][/list][p]These heroes will gain access to the unique abilities of the Summoning branch and become stronger as summoners on the battlefield through their minions.[/p][p]What about the resources already invested in training these heroes, you ask? The answer is simple: we will reset the upgraded skills in the Academy and return all runes and gold spent in full. This way, you can redistribute them as you see fit![/p][p]To train heroes in the Summoning branch, you will need new Summoning Runes and gold coins.  Summoning Runes can be obtained just like other runes:[/p][list][*][p]In the market, as a regular resource[/p][/*][*][p]At points of interest during matches[/p][/*][*][p]By defeating bosses[/p][/*][*][p]By opening event chests[/p][/*][*][p]Or you can buy sets in the bank — quick and convenient![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Hero Rebalance[/b][/h2][p][b]Jabir: [/b] With the arrival of Roxy in the world of Singoru, Jabir's times have become difficult. He quickly realized that he was outmatched by the innate talent of the young demoness in controlling living flame. But he was not ready to give up.  In search of new weapons, he turned to ancient legends of a powerful artifact that grants control over fire. That’s when he found the magical lamp — the [i]Wishbringer[/i]. [b]Brave ones![/b]

We present to your attention a major new update for The Braves! We have lots of news, both big and small, so let's not waste time and quickly find out what awaits you!

[h2]New modes: Chase and Invasion[/h2]

We've prepared a series of new challenges for you - location modes. Each mode will specialize in a specific type of resource. So if you need hero manga to strengthen your heroes, then welcome to the "Chase" mode. And if you need construction materials for your base or runes for training at the Academy, it's better to choose the "Invasion" mode.
These modes are available in all locations, but certain conditions in normal and hardcore modes must be met to unlock them.
All game modes are available in each location, but certain conditions in normal and hardcore modes must be completed to unlock them.

[b]The progression system is built logically:[/b] for example, to unlock the "Invasion" mode in the "Forest" location on "Easy" difficulty, you first need to complete the "Easy" level in the "Graveyard" location in normal mode.

[b]Important note:[/b] resistance levels may vary even within the same location.
Don't worry about planning your path - the game will clearly show which stages and at what difficulty level need to be completed to unlock new opportunities.

Let's take a closer look at each of the new modes:

[h3]"Chase" mode[/h3]

Something incredible has happened in Singoru. The monsters that used to act chaotically have suddenly united around the strongest. They have chosen leaders for themselves - powerful creatures that they began to worship as deities. These leaders are not only smarter and stronger than their brethren, but also have a magical connection with ancient altars that grant them immortality.
We've tried to make each match in "Chase" mode unique. Each location has its own leader monster with special abilities and behavior tactics.

[b]How the new mode works:[/b]

From the very beginning of the match, an immortal leader monster will be chasing you. It cannot be killed in the usual way - it will pursue you until the altars connected to it are destroyed. But be careful: the monster won't just follow you. It will use its abilities to block paths, slow you down, or even call for reinforcements.

[b]Main objective[/b] - act quickly. Explore the location, find the altars and destroy them before the monster catches up with you. But remember: the enemy won't sit idly by! The longer you delay, the more dangerous the situation becomes. And if you don't manage to sever the monster leader's connection with the altars by the end of the match, you will lose this battle.

[h3]"Invasion" mode[/h3]

The standard rules no longer apply - now every match turns into a task to eliminate the threat. Ready for a real challenge? We present the new "Invasion" mode - dynamic, intense, requiring not only strength but also a well-thought-out strategy.

[b]How the new mode works:[/b]

At the beginning of the game, portals appear in the location and you have 5 minutes to destroy them and defeat the guardians - the Ethereal Hounds.
The higher the difficulty, the more stages: from one to three, each lasting 5 minutes.
Let's look at Easy difficulty: as soon as you appear in the location, a countdown timer starts. Portals appear on the map, and within the allotted 5 minutes of the stage you need to destroy the portals and defeat the invaders that appear from these very portals. If the portals or Ethereal Hounds are not destroyed when time runs out - it counts as a defeat.
If you manage to destroy the portals and Ethereal Hounds within the allotted time, then at the end of each stage you will face the location boss containing coveted resources and equipment.

[h2]Match duration changes[/h2]

Changes have occurred in the world of Singoru! Match durations have been shortened, making them more dynamic and exciting. This innovation not only speeds up gameplay but also makes it more thrilling. Now you'll have more opportunities to test your skills in a short time and enjoy every moment on the battlefield!
Let's see how much time it will take:
[list]
[*] Easy difficulty level of Normal mode, Chase and Invasion modes can be completed in just 5 minutes;
[*] Medium - in 10 minutes;
[*] Hard, Impossible and Infernal - in just 15 minutes;
[*] Hardcore mode match duration remains unchanged at 15 minutes.
[/list]
With the reduction in match duration, the number of bosses in locations has also changed:
[list]
[*] On Easy difficulty - 1 boss
[*] On Medium difficulty - 2 bosses
[*] On Hard, Impossible and Infernal - 3 bosses
[/list]
What about rewards, you ask? Although there are fewer bosses, the amount of rewards remains the same. So you'll be able to get the same resources and equipment items in less time!

[h2]Prism fragments turn into star coins[/h2]

We've carefully analyzed your feedback and would like to note the impressive efficiency of some players in collecting prism fragments. Unfortunately, the number of fragments obtained has significantly exceeded our expectations, creating a certain imbalance in the game economy.

We've also noticed that the current fragment usage system turned out to be quite limited and didn't provide sufficient variety of gameplay opportunities. We strive to offer you broader prospects and diverse options for using in-game currency.

Considering your comments that the ability to obtain resources for summoning heroes and weapons is wonderful, but gameplay shouldn't be limited to just this, we've decided to make significant changes. We're abandoning prism fragments and introducing a new currency - Star Coins.

In return, we're introducing a more flexible system where [b]Star Coins[/b] can be used to purchase a wide range of in-game items and opportunities. This will make gameplay more varied and exciting, giving you more choices and opportunities for development.

At this stage of implementing Star Coins, you can expect:
[list]
[*] Hero fragments in the "Hero Fragments" section of the Market
[*] Transformation Masks in the "Resources" section of the Market
[*] Various character appearances in the Tavern
[*] Ether and Infinity Prisms in the Bank and Market buildings at the following rates:
[*] Ether Prism - 150 Star Coins
[*] Infinity Prism - 300 Star Coins
[/list]
[u]All prism fragments you currently have will be automatically converted into the new currency - Star Coins at a 1:1 ratio.[/u]

In the future, we plan to expand the list of available items for Star Coins to make your gameplay even more exciting and varied.

Join the new era of Singoru and enjoy the updated economy system!

[h2]Gift Marathon: Monthly[/h2]

[b]Monthly[/b]

The Monthly Gift Marathon starts with the first monthly marathon that will last 28 days, after which it will switch to a cyclical mode.
The Monthly Gift Marathon will offer you 28 days of continuous reward collection. No tasks - just log into the game and claim your daily bonuses.
After completing the main stage, the gift marathon will switch to [b]cyclical mode[/b], where the rewards will change, but you'll be able to receive them using the familiar scheme. This will allow you to plan your time and always know when to expect new gifts.
No need to complete complex conditions or special requirements - just play and receive your bonuses. If you want more, we've prepared a premium part of the marathon with additional bonuses.

[h2]Sight customization[/h2]

Now you can flexibly customize your sight in the game.

[b]Auto-aim[/b] - the classic mode where the game automatically helps you acquire targets. Perfect for dynamic shootouts and beginners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a1431e8bb4059b648fdd4b65a748aa1c9c666390.gif[/img]

[b]Cursor aiming[/b] - advanced mode with full control over shots. Now you can precisely direct weapons through the cursor, which is especially important for experienced players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8ecba610a3435cf7c851684638ff456ac541aed0.gif[/img]

We've added a convenient switch so you can choose the most comfortable aiming method. On PC, you have two options:
[list]
[*] Directly in battle by pressing a special button (F).
[*] Through game settings.
[/list]
In the mobile version, which will be released soon, you'll only be able to change the aiming mode through the settings menu.

[b]The new feature currently only affects certain skills[/b]. We've compiled their list:
[list]
[*] Stone Shrapnel
[*] Earth Barrage
[*] Crushing Blow
[*]  Compass of Pain
[*] Thunder Arrows
[*] Arrow Thrower
[*] Steel Fan
[/list]
The choice is yours! Customize the aiming type to suit your playstyle. Remember: in cursor aiming mode, shot accuracy depends entirely on your skills and experience.

[h2]Changes to Daily Roulette Rewards[/h2]

No more "7500"! Now the size of the daily reward in coveted gold coins depends on your progress in locations:
[list]
[*] Starting from the Forest location (Easy), you can receive from 1,500 to 6,000 gold coins.
[*] From the Mycelium location (Easy), you can receive from 3,000 to 12,000 gold coins.
[*] From Bran Castle location (Easy), you can receive from 30,000 to 120,000 gold coins.
[*] From the Ridge location (Medium), you can receive from 450,000 to 1,800,000 gold coins!
[*] A pleasant addition to the daily reward can be Star Coins and Gems!
[/list]

[h2]New Sets in the Bank[/h2]

The Goblin Bank has also expanded its assortment and is ready to offer new items to the Braves:

[b]Daily Ether Prism Sets:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 Ether Prisms
[/list]
[b]Daily Infinity Prism Sets:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 Infinity Prisms
[/list]
[b]Monthly Prism Sets:[/b]
[list]

[*] 50 Infinity Prisms
[/list]
[b] Beginner's Set 1:[/b]
[list]

[*] 20,000 Gold Coins
[*] 10 Ether Prisms
[*] Rare hero Aerin
[/list]
[b]Beginner's Set 2:[/b]
[list]
[*] 200 Gems

[*] 10 Infinity Prisms
[*] Epic rarity Sorcerer's Ring
[*] 30 Stone
[*] 30 Wood
[/list]
[b]Beginner's Set 3:[/b]
[list]
[*] 300 Gems
[*] 75,000 Gold Coins
[*] 20 Ether Prisms
[*] Epic rarity Sorcerer's Robe
[*] 40 random blueprints
[*] 40 Hero Manga volumes
[/list]
[b]Beginner's Set 4:[/b]
[list]
[*] 500 Gems
[*] 100,000 Gold Coins

[*] 50 random runes
[*] Epic rarity Arsonist's Staff
[/list]
[b]Beginner's Set 5:[/b]
[list]

[/list]
Please note that the new beginner sets must be purchased sequentially. To purchase set number 5, you will need to purchase the four previous sets first.

[h2]New Quests[/h2]

We haven't forgotten about quests for adventurers. The Town Hall now has two new quest chains for the new modes. Let's take a closer look at the new quest chains:
[b]Chase Mode Quest Chain:[/b]
[list]
[*] 29 new task groups
[*] Each group contains 5 tasks related to the new mode
[*] As rewards for completing them, you can receive Ether and Infinity Prisms, Gems, Hero Manga volumes, as well as gold coins!
[/list]

[b]Invasion Mode Quest Chain:[/b]
[list]
[*] 30 new task groups
[*] Each group contains 6 tasks related to the new mode
[*] As rewards for completing them, you can receive Ether and Infinity Prisms, Gems, construction materials, various runes for strengthening your heroes at the Academy, as well as gold coins!
[/list]
Go forth, meet adventure, and challenge the monster leaders and alien invaders. After all, only you can protect Singoru from the forces of evil!

[h2]Pity Counter[/h2]

Previously, the guarantee for obtaining a legendary hero or equipment item in Portals had to be tracked manually. Now we've implemented an automatic pity counter for the Portal building and event activities in the Market building!
This innovation will allow you to easily see how many summon attempts remain until guaranteed receipt of a legendary hero or equipment item, making the summoning process more convenient and transparent!

[h2]Resource Conversion for Gems[/h2]

Lacking resources to upgrade your favorite hero, construct buildings, or improve equipment levels? No problem! Now you can quickly and conveniently purchase missing resources for Gems. This will help you speed up progress and avoid long waits.

How to use it: Simply click the hero upgrade button in the Tavern building, even if you don't have enough Hero Manga volumes to upgrade the hero, and the game will automatically offer to purchase the missing resources for Gems.

Use this feature to make your gameplay even more comfortable and efficient!

[h2]Hero Rebalancing[/h2]

[h3]Dancing Flame:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Specialization "+2 to Fire Dragon level at match start" moved from Mythic to Epic rarity, also reduced value from 2 -> 1
[*] Added new Mythic rarity specialization increasing Fire Dragon and its evolution damage by 100%
[/list]

[h3]Elusive Ice:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Specialization "+2 to Ice Dragon level at match start" moved from Mythic to Epic rarity, also reduced value from 2 -> 1
[*] Added new Mythic rarity specialization increasing Ice Dragon and its evolution damage by 100%
[*] Changed conditions for transformation into dragon form - now occurs when dealing damage rather than receiving it as before.
[/list]
[h3]Antony - Flesh Tormentor:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cooldown time for "Blood Rain" specialization reduced from 45s -> 15s
[/list]

[h2]New Hero Skins[/h2]

Our heroes have received new skins, and some have gotten them for the first time:

[list]
[*] Dungeon Lord Bob Bonecrusher: +2.5% to attack
[*] Midnight Dungeon Princess: +2.5% to skill duration
[*] Captain Barrett: +1.25% to run speed
[*] Great Nameless Snake Mage Velikia: +0.7% to attack per 10 match levels
[*] Exalted Limuru: 2.5% chance to deal double damage
[*] Exalted Aerin: -2.5% to skill cooldown (can only be obtained by purchasing Beginner's Set 5)
[*] Earth Adept Stefan: 10% chance to restore 2% health when taking damage
[*] Mysterious Cat Tieme: -2.5% to skill cooldown
[*] Arrogant Diva Bastet: +1.25% to run speed
[*] Moon Guardian Riley: 2.5% chance for skill reactivation
[*] Virtuoso Mage Nailus: +0.7% to attack per 10 match levels
[*] Balance Servant Kaliz'k: +0.7% to health per 10 match levels
[*] Chef Terra: +2.5% to armor
[*] Wind Princess Sylpha: 2.75% chance to deal triple damage
[/list]
You can already find them in the Tavern and purchase them for Transformation Masks, Gems, Star Coins, or in the new Beginner's Set!

[h2]Opening of New Portals[/h2]

Do you hear the echoes of battle, brave ones? Ether waves bring new heroes to Singoru, and they definitely know how to win, even when outnumbered. Welcome [b]Battle Heroes Portal and Battle Artifacts Portal[/b]!
The Battle Heroes Portal features three new, unique heroes. What can they do? How will they surprise us? Let's take a look together:

[h3]Kaliz'k[/h3]
[i][b]Legendary Defense Hero.[/b][/i]

Once he loved bringing joy by giving gifts, but one day he lost everything and took the dark path of necromancy. After years, he's ready to give gifts again, though now they're meant for enemies who probably won't like them...
Let's look at his abilities:

[b]Legendary Rarity:[/b]

[*] -50% to Skeleton Summon and its evolution cooldown
[*] 2.5% chance to summon skeleton minion when killing an enemy
[*] 5% chance for festive chest instead of regular one. Festive chest can only contain bomb, magnet or time freeze
[*] +15% to health

[*] +1 resurrection
[*] Fully restores health when resurrected

[*] -7% to other weapons' damage
[*] +1 Skeleton Summon evolution level: Death Knight
[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] +2 levels to Skeleton Summon at match start
[*] Summons 5 skeleton minions when resurrected
[/list]

[h3]Sylpha[/h3]
[i][b] Legendary Attack Hero.[/b][/i]
Perhaps somewhere between worlds awaits the answer - why she became the one with whom the wind speaks as an equal. But while it's in her hands and the sky is overhead, she continues her path. After all, you can't hold the wind - you can only fly with it.
While Sylpha floats in the clouds, let's look at her abilities:

[list]

[*] +20% to projectile speed
[*] +15% to run speed
[*] +100% to knockback force

[*] +20% to air skill area
[*] +35% to Air Elemental and its evolution damage
[*] -7% to other weapons' damage
[*] +1 Air Elemental evolution level: Storm Guardian

[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] +2 to Air Elemental level at match start
[*] 10% chance for double air skill damage
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2fa186d81a5324f63fc4d82332abb33105aa33a7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5b593d47af02961632c2f221e532670875e654d0.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Terra[/h3] [i][b]Epic Defense Heroine. [/b][/i]
A mysterious and talented magical sculptor whose hands can turn ordinary stone into living works of art. Her name, meaning "earth", perfectly reflects her connection to natural materials and earth magic. Terra can not only create monumental sculptures but breathe life into them, endowing them with magical power.
Let's take a closer look at this heroine:

[b]Epic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] +35% to Stone Golem and its evolution damage
[*] -7% to other weapons' damage
[*] +100% to item pickup radius
[*] +100% to minion health
[*] 1% chance to heal 1% health when picking up item or experience
[*] +15% to armor
[*] When dealing damage with earth skill, has chance to reduce enemy attack by 25% for 5 sec
[*] +20% to earth skill size
[/list]

[list]
[*] +1 Stone Golem evolution level: Stone Guardian
[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] When picking up item, summons Royal Golem. 5 sec cooldown
[*] +2 to Stone Golem level at match start
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/1bf0ba3d8b20bf737966e503d9947556b6ff6387.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/334de62bb367f75e0f8fcfd835d94ce82c3a4f5e.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Lord of the Dead - Legendary Skeleton Summon[/h3]
[i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Skeleton Summon skill.[/b][/i]
[list]

[/list]

[h3]Song of the Heavens - Legendary Air Elemental[/h3]
[i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Air Elemental skill. [/b][/i]
[list]

[*] +5% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Air Elemental skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +2 to number of Air Elementals

[/list]

[i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Stone Golem skill.[/b][/i]

[*] +30% to Stone Golem damage at Uncommon rarity
[*] +5% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Stone Golem skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +1 to number of Stone Golems
[*] +1 to Stone Guardian evolution level at Mythic rarity
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2a9d5319c33db800f93054a15e6cab165c281755.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/167030d2da0ead416274235767d06a8a0704fbc4.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Skills[/h2]

New heroes have come to Singoru, ushering in a new era of summoners. Fight side by side with new allies and protect Singoru from the forces of evil!
Let's take a closer look at them:

[list]
[*] [b]Stone Golem[/b]. Type: Attacking. Element: Earth. When activating the skill, a Stone Golem is summoned on the battlefield - a primal force of earth capable of crushing enemies with powerful blows that shake the ground.
[*] [b]Skeleton Summon[/b]. Type: Attacking. Element: Spirit. When activating the skill, a Skeleton Minion appears on the battlefield - a dark embodiment of forbidden magic, ready to follow its master's commands and fight enemies with sinister force.
[*] [b]Air Elemental[/b]. Type: Attacking. Element: Wind. When activating the skill, an Air Elemental appears on the battlefield - an entity embodied from pure air, ready to unleash powerful gusts of wind that sweep away everything in their path.
[*] [b]Stone Guardian[/b]. Type: Evolution. Element: Earth. Recipe: Stone Golem (level 8) + Repelling Minion (level 1). When evolving, a [b]Stone Guardian[/b] appears on the battlefield - a mighty golem created from ancient stones and minerals, possessing incredible durability and hurling huge rocks at its enemies.
[*] [b]Death Knight[/b]. Type: Evolution. Element: Spirit. Recipe: Skeleton Summon (level 8) + Many Minions (level 1). When evolving, a Death Knight appears on the battlefield - once a mighty warrior who fell in battles against monster hordes. His blows leave behind bloody pools that drain the life of enemies who dare stand where the fallen once stood.
[*] [b]Storm Guardian[/b]. Type: Evolution. Element: Wind. Recipe: Air Elemental (level 8) + Swift Minion (level 1). When evolving, a Storm Guardian appears on the battlefield - a majestic being imbued with the power of storms and winds. It can hurl spheres of air that rush toward enemies with incredible speed, dealing damage.
[/list]

The Braves' arsenal has also been supplemented with new passive skills to strengthen their minions:
[list]
[*] Mighty Minion (5 levels): Increases minion damage by 10% per level.
[*] Accelerated Minion (5 levels): Reduces Minion cooldown.
[*] First level - by 9%
[*] Second level - by 17%
[*] Third level - by 23%
[*] Fourth level - by 29%
[*] Fifth level - by 34%
[*] Healthy Minion (5 levels): Increases minion health by 10% per level.
[*] Many Minions (2 levels): Increases number of summoned minions by 1 per level.
[*] Swift Minion (5 levels): Increases minion movement speed by 10% per level.
[*] Repelling Minion (5 levels): Increases minion knockback force by 50% per level.
[/list]

But that's not all - old evolutions have also undergone some changes! We're happy to present their list:

[list]
[*] Earth Barrage. Type: Attacking. Element: Earth. Recipe: Stone Shrapnel (level 8) + Academic Record (level 1). Replaces Boulder evolution. Unleash a barrage of projectiles upon enemies that sweeps away everything in its path!
[*] Explosive Shards. Type: Attacking. Element: Water. Recipe: Frost Shards (level 8) + Piercing Strikes (level 1). Replaces Supernova evolution. An explosive ice projectile that flies behind and deals damage in explosion radius.
[*] Queen's Song. Type: Attacking. Element: Water. Recipe: Throwing Disc (level 8) + Hasty (level 1). By popular demand, we've added additional projectiles to this evolution, making it even deadlier for your enemies
[/list]

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]

New skills need new weapons, right? And these weapons have already been abundantly supplied to the vaults of all the evil bosses of Singoru and, of course, to the Eternal Soul Portal, Battle Heroes Portal and Battle Artifacts Portal. We present to you:

[h3]Herald of Bones[/h3][i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Skeleton Summon skill.[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] +25% to Skeleton Summon damage at Uncommon rarity
[*] +4% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Skeleton Summon skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +6% to all skills' damage at Legendary rarity
[*] +1 to Death Knight evolution level at Mythic rarity
[/list]
[h3]Harmony of Wind[/h3] [i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Air Elemental skill. [/b][/i]
[list]
[*] +25% to Air Elemental damage at Uncommon rarity
[*] +4% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Air Elemental skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +6% to all skills' damage at Legendary rarity
[*] +1 to Storm Guardian evolution level at Mythic rarity
[/list]
[h3]Mud Animator[/h3] [i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Stone Golem skill.[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] +25% to Stone Golem damage at Uncommon rarity
[*] +4% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Stone Golem skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +6% to all skills' damage at Legendary rarity
[*] +1 to Stone Guardian evolution level at Mythic rarity
[/list]

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]

New heroes - new achievements. For fans of expanding their profiles, both in-game and on STEAM, we've prepared 27 new achievements related to new heroes, modes and bosses!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca6ed5eecf6cb219a48414d868e1190854b9e35e.png[/img]
Also, to celebrate the update, we've prepared a mysterious code for you: [b]windofchange[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/92ffd8a382c79233ad4bc5e19e50c850c013eaea.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca6ed5eecf6cb219a48414d868e1190854b9e35e.png[/img]

That's all for now, Braves. We hope you'll appreciate the innovations! Stay with us, share your impressions of the game - we're always happy to hear feedback and make it even better!

Pre-Update Discounts
notes.notes:
Brave ones!

notes.title: New Year's Miracle update announcement!
New Year's update!
notes.notes:
Brave Ones!

Have you been anxiously waiting for an update? Well, it's finally here, so put on your best armor, grab a weapon, and let's go on an adventure! But first, here’s what's new!

[h2]Hero Soul Fragments Exchange at the Market[/h2]
Some of the most experienced players have accumulated too many Soul Fragments to count, and those are just collecting dust in warehouses... So, what can one do with them? Luckily, an enterprising trader at the Market is now offering to exchange the Fragments of one hero's soul for the other's!
[b]Warning! [/b]
[list]
[*] you can only trade for Soul Fragments belonging to heroes that you already own;
[*] you can only exchange Fragments of the same rarity.
[/list]
[h2]Guarantor in marketplace rewards.[/h2]
Many people have gotten used to the constant randomized marketplace reward events, but what if I told you that now every chest, regardless of its value will now have its own guarantor! Yes brave ones, now you will definitely be able to get your long awaited reward even if you are very unlucky. 
The guarantor and the number of attempts can vary from event to event and chest to chest. To find out what will fall out in the guarantee and the exact number of attempts you need to make to get it - open the hint window, which is on each chest in the upper right corner.

[h2]New Event: Singoru-Style Heist[/h2]
The Goblin Bank prints valuable securities, but its vault has come under attack. The papers were stolen, and it falls to you to track down the thieves: the Mysterious Mr. S already picked up the criminals' trail and requests your help! How could one refuse such a plea? The Goblin Bank owner has paid dearly for his indiscretion, but a secret patron might help the establishment get out of this mess... For a sizable fee, of course! Hit the road, hunt down the crooks at every location, reclaim the stolen goods, and then you can exchange them for some neat rewards at the Market:
[b][h3]New Enemy: Goblin Thief.[/h3][/b] The Goblin Bank owner paid a heavy price for taking pity on a few wayward goblins and offering them a job. The scoundrels had spent months planning their robbery, and now the unfortunate banker lost many valuable securities, while the thieving goblins scattered around the known lands. Look for them around Singoru during the event, and make sure to investigate the new point of interest displayed as the event token. The cowardly Goblin Thief will run for it as soon as you get close, giving you an opportunity to catch him. But be careful and don't lose sight of your target, for you will never find the rascal if you let him run too far!
[h3][b]New Mechanics: Fleeing Enemy.[/b][/h3] We thought about it and decided that monsters chasing down players is getting dull. Let's welcome a new enemy type, such as the Goblin Thief, that comes with unique behavior mechanics! This time, YOU will need to run after them and don't let the sneaky pests get too far away, otherwise they'll escape, leaving you without a valuable reward. Be careful, since this kind of opponent can easily run past the boss arena. Watch that timer!
Event Token: Bill of Exchange. A security paper printed by Goblin Bank employees. You'll be able to cash out any collected Bills at the Market and receive valuable rewards. Get those tokens by defeating Goblin Thieves.

[h3][b]Event Rewards: [/b][/h3]
- Try your luck at the Market and exchange event tokens for a random reward:
[list]
[*] Hero Soul Fragments;
[*] Academy Runes;
[*] Prism Fragments;
[*] Ether Prisms;
[*] Eternity Prisms;
[*] Gold Coins;
[*] Building materials;
[*] Heroic Manga;
[*] Blueprints.
[/list]

[h2]Gift Marathon: Singoru-Style Heist[/h2]
We're kicking off a series of Gift Marathons and decided to coincide the very first one with the new event. This means that you can receive the following rewards completely free of charge: Gold, Ether and Eternity Prisms, Transformation Masks, as well as Event Tokens: Bills of Exchange.
But that's not all! In addition to the standard Gift Marathon, there will also be a premium one, with even more gifts and a cherry on top in the form of the unique Mysterious Mr. S skin — Godfather Mr. S! The mysterious hero declared a vendetta against the Goblin Thieves... As it turns out, the old banker enjoyed his personal protection.

[h2]Effects Transperacy[/h2]
It often happens that, by the end of the match—or even at around the middle point for some of the more audacious heroes—the abundance of different skills active at the same time makes it difficult to see what's actually going on behind all the special effects. The battlefield situation should be crystal clear to our Brave Ones, so that they may come out victorious from any kind of situation. That's why we present a new addition to the game's settings menu, currently running in test mode — the graphical effects transparency slider!
The lower you set it, the less noticeable the visual effects from your characters' skills will be. Feel free to customize this option as you see fit!

[h2]Streamlining the New Player Experience[/h2]

Being brave can be difficult... Some think that it's actually too difficult. That's why we've simplified many of the game's aspects that players can have trouble with when starting out. This includes the following:
Forest location will now be easier to clear, with significantly fewer monsters that can use the Dash ability;
[list]
[*] the Town Hall will now offer increased rewards for the missions in the Forest (up to Hellish difficulty), the Laboratory (up to Impossible difficulty), and the Cemetery (up to Medium difficulty) locations;
[*] there will also be increased rewards for killing bosses in the Forest (up to Hellish difficulty), the Laboratory (up to Impossible difficulty), and the Cemetery (up to Medium difficulty) locations;
[*] more rewards will be included in the location-specific and set offers for Forest, Laboratory, Graveyard, Mycelium, Beginner's Set, Eternity Set, Eternity Warrior Set, Eternity Explorer Set, Explorer Set, and Warrior Set. Up-and-coming Brave Ones will now have an easier time exploring new horizons!
[/list]
[h2]Updated Academy Skills[/h2]
The Academy approved a new curriculum, changing some disciplines, and putting more focus on some of the others. Here's the information we got about the changes from the Dean:
[list]
[*] for Quick Feet, support branch skill: Bonus increased from +5% on Legendary rarity and +7.5% on Mythical to +7.5% on Legendary and +15% on Mythical;
[*] for Magnetism support branch skill: The skill now only works for EXP, while the pick-up radius has been increased from 60%/100%/135% to 75%/125%/200% on Epic/Legendary/Mythical rarities, respectively.
[/list]
[h2]Updated Gear and Hero Special Effects[/h2]
Aside from Academy skills, certain special equipment item effects have also been updated, namely:
[b]Warrior Greaves:[/b]
[list]
[*] +125% to EXP pick-up radius on Epic Rarity, instead of +100% general pick-up radius;
[*] +60% to EXP pick-up radius for every 10 levels gained during a match on Mythic Rarity, instead of +45% general pick-up radius.
[/list]
[b]Barbarian Boots:[/b]
[list]
[*] +125% to EXP pick-up radius on Epic Rarity, instead of +100% general pick-up radius.
[/list]
[b]Ronin Sandals:[/b]
[list]
[*] +125% to EXP pick-up radius on Epic Rarity, instead of +100% general pick-up radius.
[/list]
[b]Truffaldino Hero:[/b]
[list]
[*] +180% to EXP pick-up radius on Epic Rarity, instead of +150% general pick-up radius.
[/list]
[h2]New Portals Opening[/h2]
Can you feel the cold emanating from the portals? The waves of ether bring new heroes to Singoru, and they know exactly how to cool their enemies' ardor... So, let’s welcome the Portals of Winter Cold and Snow Fighting!
Three new, unique characters await you in the Portal of the Winter Cold. What can they do? What surprises do they bring? Let's take a look:

[h3]Aurora.[/h3][b] Legendary Support Hero. [/b]
Aurora grew up amidst the shimmering beauty of the snowy lands and the unearthly dance of the northern lights in the night sky. In her homeland, located at the heart of the frozen tundra, Aurora was revered as the goddess of prosperity and the bringer of good tidings. It's believed that those bearing her blessing are destined for greatness... And here's what she brings to the battlefield:
[h3][b]Legendary Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Northern Lights. Aurora has a chance to summon the Northern Lights upon dealing damage with any skill. Opponents affected by their AoE deal less damage, their health is drained, and they're pushed away from the epicenter of the Northern Lights. Aurora herself, on the contrary, receives a temporary attack power boost;
[*] Frozen Waters. Water skills and their evolutions gain a chance to freeze opponents for 1 sec. Be careful, though, as this skill will only slow down bosses instead;
[*] +100% to Fire and Ice Dragons' and their evolutions' AoE;
[*] +125% knockback force;
[*] -15% Max HP.
[/list]
[h3][b]Mythic Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Wisdom of the North. Aurora has a chance to receive the Wisdom of the North buff upon dealing damage, significantly increasing the amount of EXP she gains for the next 6 sec. The skill then goes into cooldown for 50 sec.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/91e459658ad43a1d2383316f1166e9d1504fd3d1.png[/img]
[h3]Visconti.[/h3] [b]Legendary Damage-dealing Hero.[/b] 
It happens that, when the waves of ether twist and toss the souls of heroes around, sometimes two of them end up in the same body, thrown onto the shores of Singoru. Visconti is one such case, with two principles constantly fighting for control over his mind: an inveterate villain and a pure-hearted, righteous man... Which side will you support? And while you're pondering that eternal question, let's take a look at this hero's skills:
[h3][b]Legendary Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Garment of Light. Upon dealing damage with a Holy skill, Visconti has a chance to gain the Garment of Light buff for 10 sec. In this form, the damage and AoE of his Holy skills will increase, and their cooldown time will be shortened. This ability can activate once every 45 sec.;
[*] Garment of Darkness. Upon dealing damage with a Spirit skill, Visconti has a chance to gain the Garment of Darkness buff for 10 sec., boosting the damage, projectile count, and knockback of his Spirits skills. This ability can activate once every 45 sec.;
[*] Intertwined Fates. The Thread of Life and Thread of Fate skills drop 5 times more often;
[*] +1 revival at the start of the match;
[*] +1 Thread of Life skill level at the start of the match;
[*] +1 Thread of Fate skill level at the start of the match;
[*] +1 Samsara Carpet evolution level;
[*] -25% item pick-up radius;
[*] -60% item pick-up speed.
[/list]
[h3][b]Mythic Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Ideal Garment of Light. higher Garment of Light activation rate, and its cooldown time is reduced to 20 sec.;
[*] Ideal Garment of Darkness. higher Garment of Darkness activation rate, and its cooldown time is reduced to 20 sec.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8e51cec76becc3bc1a98040845438766bc1fcc0d.png[/img]
[h3]Tempesta.[/h3] [b]Epic Defense Heroine. [/b]
Can you feel it? The air's full of electricity, and the clouds grow darker and heavier, about to burst into thunder and lightning. It's the perfect time for Tempesta, the dweller of storms, to make her entrance, ready to bring down the wrath of the heavens onto her enemies' heads!.. And now, let's take a careful look at this character's abilities:
[h3][b]Epic Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Wrath of the Heavens. Has a chance to bring down the Wrath of Heavens onto the battlefield upon dealing damage. This AoE skill deals damage to opponents and stuns them for 3 sec. Be careful, though, as this skill will only slow down bosses instead;
[*] Healing Winds. Every time Tempesta dodges an enemy attack, she heals for 2% of her Max HP;
[*] +6% projectile speed for every 5 levels gained during the match;
[*] +2% evasion rate for every 5 levels gained during the match;
[*] +50% AoE size to Lightning Strike skill and its evolutions;
[*] -3% skill duration for every 5 levels gained during the match.
[/list]
[h3][b]Legendary Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] +2% movement speed for every 5 levels gained during the match.
[/list]
[h3][b]Mythic Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] -3% skill cooldown time for every 5 levels gained during the match.
[/list]
[u][b]Three new, unique weapons await you in the Portal of Snow Fighting. Let's hear it for:[/b][/u]

[h3]Herald of the Cold.[/h3] [b]Legendary Cold Biter.[/b] 
When equipped, grants the [b]Ice Dragon skill[/b].
[list]
[*] +30% Ice Dragon skill damage on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +5% to all skills' damage on Rare Rarity;
[*] +1 Ice Dragon skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity;
[*] +350% Ice Dragon skill knockback on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +1 Kiro skill evolution level on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a91c0999a8f6e7f58a480b5bb4cf4b0a197c1324.png[/img]
[h3]Synergy.[/h3] [b]Legendary Key of Life.[/b] 
When equipped, grants the [b]Thread of Life[/b] skill. 
[list]
[*] +15% Thread of Life and Thread of Destiny skill damage on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +5% to all skills' damage on Rare Rarity;
[*] +1 Damned Souls skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity;
[*] 50% chance to double activate the Cursed Souls skill and its evolutions on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +1 Chain Reaction skill evolution level on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/c6a05801408f1c4104c6dca570eeb0ff242fdcb9.png[/img]
[h3]Storm Herald.[/h3] [b]Legendary Lightning Rod.[/b] 
When equipped, grants the [b]Lightning Strike[/b] skill.
[list]
[*] +30% Lightning Strike skill damage on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +5% to all skills' damage on Rare Rarity;
[*] +1 Lightning Strike skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity;
[*] -30% Lightning Strike skill cooldown time on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +1 Over 9000 skill evolution level on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/273c8663adcc3d5a48c829cf0cc3e0ad66075c4d.png[/img]
[h2]New Achievements[/h2]
New heroes mean new achievements. For those who enjoys updating their profiles, both in-game and on Steam, we've prepared 3 new achievements linked to Aurora, Visconti, and Tempesta.

[h2]New Hero Skins[/h2]
The newcomers Aurora and Tempesta have already received their first skins:
Exalted Aurora: 5% more EXP drops from enemies;
Exalted Tempesta : +0.7% Max HP for every 10 levels gained in the match.
You can already find these at the Tavern and buy them with Gems or Transformation Masks.

[h2]Player Profile: En Masse Achievement Selection[/h2]
Tired of selecting your achievements one by one when decorating your profile? Well, now you won't have to, because we've added the option to select achievements en masse, so that you can adjust their order of appearance in the Achievements Showcase in just a few clicks.

[h2]Festive Spirit Comes to Town[/h2]
Christmas and New Year holidays are upon us! As you know, even in the harshest of times, a grain of joy and happiness can light up even the darkest night. That's why there will also be a festival in our city, and right now you can already see how everything's transformed on the eve of the celebration. Time to kick back and enjoy the festive atmosphere! We hope you will like this change of scenery, Brave Ones!

[h2]Sorting Added to the Tavern and the Academy[/h2]
Finally, the Tavern and the Academy buildings will now save the last sorting settings you've used, meaning that the order in which you prefer to view your heroes will remain even after entering and exiting a match.

We also give you a mysterious code in honor of the update: [b]GREATHEIST[/b]

That's it for now, Brave Ones!Congratulations on reaching the first month of winter, and we hope that you'll like all the innovations this update brings! Stay tuned and share your impressions, since, as always, we're happy to hear your feedback!

notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.notes:
Brave Ones!
 
October is coming to an end, and we all know what that means... Halloween is coming to Singoru, no one can ignore this holiday! Put on your spookiest costumes, arm yourself with the most frightening smile, and go forth to adventures!
 
[h2]New Event – Halloween[/h2]

The days are growing shorter, while the nights are getting longer and colder. The peasants, finishing this year's final harvest, have begun to find strange sweets in the fields. How did they get there, and who have scattered them around? The answer is simple — a new evil has befallen Singoru, and only the bravest will be able to face it and obtain worthy trophies!
[b]New Boss – Sinister Scarecrow.[/b] Animated by childhood fears, this garden scarecrow now fashions itself a big bad villain... Funny, huh? Well, don't let your guard done just yet, since this opponent has a set of dangerous abilities that can make even the most seasoned adventurers sweat! Throughout the event, it will appear at the 11th minute on the map of your choosing — simply look for the new icon in the form of the Cursed Candy event token.
[b]Event Token – Cursed Candy.[/b] This ominous candy seems to have a mind of its own... You are unlikely to be tempted to eat it, but rumor has it that there are real connoisseurs for this kind of sweets on the market. Collect Cursed Candies by defeating the Sinister Scarecrow.
[b]Event Rewards: [/b]
Try your luck and exchange event tokens for a random reward at the Market:
[list]
[*] New unique Scarecrow Set;
[*] Academy Runes;
[*] Prism Fragments;
[*] Prisms of the Ether;
[*] Prisms of Eternity;
[*] Gold Coins;
[*] Building materials;
[*] Heroic Manga;
[*] Blueprints.
[/list]
You can exchange event tokens for new character skins at the Tavern. Read on for more details.
 
[h2]New Armor Set [/h2]
By exchanging event tokens for prizes at the Market, you have a rare chance to get the unique Scarecrow Set. As is tradition, your efforts will be well-rewarded, because this set's stats are significantly higher, compared to all others that can be obtained outside of events. Want to know more about its properties?

[h3]Scarecrow Rags[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Quick Metabolism skill will activate more frequently;
[*] +15% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity;
[*] The Quick Metabolism skill will activate even more frequently while your hero is standing in place on Epic Rarity;
[*] +13% evasion rate on Legendary Rarity;
[*] -13% incoming damage on Mythic Rarity;
[/list]
[h3]Scarecrow Head[/h3]
[list]
[*] +15% revival healing bonus on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +15% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity;
[*] +5 sec. to post-revival invulnerability duration on Epic Rarity;
[*] +1 revive on Legendary Rarity
[*] +10% to skill AoE while your hero is standing in place on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[h3]Scarecrow Boots[/h3]
[list]
[*] +100% item pick-up speed on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +15% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity;
[*] +5% movement speed on Epic Rarity;
[*] 15% chance to double-activate skills on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +20% projectile speed while your hero is standing in place on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[h3]Scarecrow Gloves[/h3]
[list]
[*] 10% fire rate on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +15% max HP on Rare Rarity;
[*] +100% knockback while your hero is standing in place on Epic Rarity;
[*] 15% chance to deal double damage on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +20% skill duration while your hero is standing in place on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[h3]Scarecrow Vine[/h3]
[list]
[*] Applies 2.5% slowdown to enemies on skill hit;
[*] +15% max HP on Rare Rarity;
[*] +4 skill skips during the match on Epic Rarity;
[*] +4 skill bans during the match on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +4 skill rerolls during the match on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
 
The Set Bonus is an active skill: While your hero is wearing the full Scarecrow Set, pumpkins will explode and crows fly across the entire battlefield once every 30 seconds, pushing all on-screen enemies away from the explosion epicenter and causing 500% attack damage.
 
[h2]New Portals are Opening[/h2]
The Ether Ocean has turned crimson red and revealed new heroes ready to fight the monster hordes. Want to know more about them? Then behold — the Portals of the Otherworld and Cursed Items!
Three new, unique heroes await you in the Portal of the Other World. Let's give three cheers for...
[h3]Headless Thomas.[/h3] [b]Legendary Hero[/b]. 
It's always best to keep your head about you, right? Well, poor Thomas failed to follow this golden rule... Too bad for his enemies, though, since this hero, clad in sturdy armor and wielding his faithful twin blades, is going to get them even from beyond the grave! Let's take a look at his skills:
[b]Legendary Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gravely Cold Strike. Hitting an enemy with the Whirlwind of Blades or the Bloody Harvest skill may stun them for 2 seconds. Be careful, as this skill won't stun bosses, but will slow them down instead;
[*] Aura of Decomposition. After dealing damage for the first time in battle, Thomas summons clouds of flies to feast on his enemies' remains. From that moment onwards and until the end of the match, the hero will be surrounded by an Aura of Decomposition, causing damage to all nearby opponents and reducing their attack power;
[*] Curse of the Headless. When dealing damage, Thomas has a chance to briefly curse everyone in an area around himself. Affected enemies will take damage, and their attack speed will be reduced;
[*] Cover of the Damned. Upon receiving damage, Thomas has a chance to become invulnerable for a short period of time. This skill can activate once every 30 seconds;
[*] +30% max HP;
[*] -10% movement speed.
[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] -30% to Whirlwind of Blades and its evolutions' cooldown time.
[*] +1 level of Unprecedented Health at the start of the match. 
[/list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/317d8ba975b76a40f410b6c350eea59789d473ef.png[/img]
[h3]Mother Bridget.[/h3] [b]Legendary Heroine.[/b]
Who will comfort those who are beyond the realm of the living? Who will sing them a lullaby and calm the souls trembling with horror and loneliness? The dead are like lost children to Mother Bridget, and as she's always ready to protect them, so do they, in turn, come to her aid. What can this heroine do on the battlefield?
[b]Legendary Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] Grief of the Ancestors. Upon dealing damage to an enemy, Mother Bridget has a chance to summon souls of the dead that will scatter around, inflicting wounds and leaving a poisonous cloud behind that will slowly drain the life of any foe in its range;
[*] Wrath of the Ancestors. When taking damage, Mother Bridget has a chance to appeal to her ancestors. This will summon ghostly skulls flying in all directions from the heroine, dealing damage and repelling nearby enemies;
[*] Knowledge of the Ancestors. Mother Bridget is guaranteed to receive a skill book for defeating mini-bosses;
[*] Proper Nutrition. Mother Bridget appreciates delicious food and drinks. Healing from all pick-up items is boosted 20%;
[*] Fragile Chests. Bombs picked up by Mother Bridget will destroy all revealed chests on the map. This skill doesn't apply to points of interest and event chests;
[*] Gifts for Mother. Magnets picked up by Mother Bridget attract all items on the map and not just experience. This skill doesn't apply to points of interest.
[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] +4 skill skips during the match;
[*] +4 skill bans during the match;
[*] +4 skill rerolls during the match.
[/list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/32e2489fbe00cb0889a2e30ad84559cfe90e26aa.png[/img]
[h3]Bloody Mary.[/h3] [b]Epic Heroine.[/b]
Don't be afraid of mirrors. No one is going to steal your soul or sneak in through them to turn your house into a horror movie set. There's no need to be afraid of mirrors anyway, because their mistress has joined the forces of good... Sound intriguing? Well, of course — Bloody Mary arrives straight from your nightmares and brings painful death to your enemies! Let's take a closer look at what this heroine is capable of on the battlefield:
[b]Epic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] Wave of Blood. Fires a large blood sphere in the direction of the cursor (or your gamepad's right stick) once every 10 seconds. The projectile explodes upon colliding with an enemy, causing damage and leaving behind a blood puddle. Enemies caught in the puddle will take damage, and their movement speed will decrease;
[*] Bloodsplosion. Upon successfully dodging an enemy attack, Bloody Mary has a chance to explode, causing damage to everyone on the battlefield;
[*] Deadly Speed. When taking damage, Bloody Mary only grows more excited for the battle at hand. The lower her health is, the higher the projectile speed of all her active skills;
[*] +15% evasion rate;
[*] +60% projectile speed for Spirit skills;

[/list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/fdbc2aedd1c66db5b5e58bff73a9374a88d9211c.png[/img]

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/e8b0f394a04cfd4c3eb8c2e0f043dfc0da87999b.png[/img]
[h2]Hero Skins[/h2]
Halloween is coming to town, and everyone knows that it's customary to dress up in scary costumes for this holiday. That's why we thought it appropriate to grant you the option to change your heroes' looks! A new tab has been added to the Hero menu at the Tavern: "Appearance." There, you will be able to see all the skins available for the selected hero, as well as any bonuses they provide.
It was decided to divide skins into the Event and Common categories.
[list]
[*] Event Skins. Skins that you can purchase with Gems or event tokens go here. Once an event ends, related skins can still be bought with Gems, plus the new currency — Masks of Transformation, which can be collected from bosses once the Halloween event ends.
[*] Common Skins. These will always be available for Gems and Masks of Transformation.
[/list]
To start things off, we've prepared a few Event Skins for you to dress up your favorite hero for the current holiday.
Applying skins will affect how your character looks in matches, as well as in all of the menus. Oh, and don't forget about the pleasant stat bonus that every skin provides!
Okay, that covers the skins, but what about Masks of Transformation? What are those, and where can you find them? Simple: the masks are a new resource that you can get for killing bosses after the Halloween event ends. The higher the difficulty level, the more Masks of Transformation you will get! Oh, and the Masks don't affect any other rewards received from bosses, but only complement them, so don't worry about them replacing any of the previously existing boss trophies.
We'll try to add new skins for your favorite heroes as often as possible, so you can look forward to more of them in the coming updates!
 
[h2]Gameplay Enhancement — Lab[/h2]
We continue to improve your gaming experience in certain locations. Today it's the Lab's turn! Local enemies will now gain difficulty level-dependent special properties.
How will this affect your experience? Simple:
[list]
[*] The Lab will be easier to clear on lower difficulties.
[*] As the difficulty grows, enemies will begin to sport new mechanics and properties, contributing to a more engaging and tactical match.
[/list]
We hope that these changes, will make your runs on the Lab location more varied and thrilling!
 
[h2]Player Profile [/h2]
As many new online features are looming on the horizon (such as in-game chats, clans, and competitions), we're now adding player profiles!
Let's take a look at why do you need a profile, and what can you do with it!
Player profile reflects their in-game progress and overall strength. In the future, you will be able to customize your profile's appearance and show off important achievements for other players to see. It also automatically displays your time spent in-game, the server and, of course, level.
[b]Anticipating the questions about how you can raise your profile level, here is the answer: [/b]
[list]
[*] by upgrading your buildings; 
[*] by leveling up heroes at the Tavern;
[*] by improving hero skills at the Academy.
[/list]
There will be other ways to level up your profile in the future, so stay tuned!

[b]Profile Appearance.[/b]
[list]
[*] Think of your profile as a personal hall of fame that showcases your favorite heroes and rare achievements, which you're especially proud of!
[*] Choose an avatar from among the portraits of your unlocked heroes and their skins. Your avatar can then be decorated with one of the many frames that will become available as you progress through the game, gain achievements, etc.
[*] Select your country's flag from the list, or just the flag of a place you really like. You can even opt to fly the colors of Singoru... The choice is entirely yours!
[/list]
In the near future and as the game develops, we plan to add new features to the profile menu, so feel free to send us your ideas and suggestions!
 
[h2]Hero Sounds[/h2]
We've begun to bestow our heroes with the gift of speech that reflects their archetypes. Funny, serious, sullen, apathetic… Each hero will now delight you with their exclamations when interacting both in the city and on the battlefield!
In the future, we will expand the range of available archetypes, so who knows... If you like the idea, then every character might even get their own unique voice lines! Everything's in your hands!
 
[h2]Hero Rebalancing[/h2]
As you may have noticed, different heroes had varying attack and health growth rates. As they levelled up, the characters' stats could grow slowly at first, but then suddenly accelerate. This led to a situation where, at low levels, the stats of one hero would be lower than those of another, but then they would suddenly switch places at higher levels.
This could potentially mislead players, so we decided to adjust the stat growth rates going forward. Now, if you see that one hero initially has higher attack than another, then you can be sure things will remain that way at higher levels, too.
How will this change affect gameplay? At lower levels (up to level 10), you may notice lower stat growth for certain heroes than they used to have until now. That said, this earlier stage of battle usually doesn't take long to complete and, at higher levels, the stat growth will become a lot more noticeable.
It's important to note that max level stats remain unchanged!
We hope that this innovation will help you better navigate character progression and give you more opportunities for strategic planning!
Additionally, as part of this rebalancing act, the stats and skills of the [b]Slippery Dave hero[/b] were slightly altered:
[list]
[*] Slippery Dave's Mythic specialization that reduces the regeneration period from the Quick Metabolism passive skill for each equipped Water Skill was adjusted from -1 sec. to -0.75 sec.
[*] His attack and HP reserve has also been increased. 
[/list]
[h2]Sorting Heroes by Class[/h2]
You can now sort your heroes by their class at the Tavern and the Academy for faster and more convenient character management!

[h2]Increased Combo Skill Drop Rates[/h2]
Does it sometimes happen that all the rerolls and skips have been spent, but the necessary skill for that sweet, sweet evolution just didn't show up? What's bad luck, and how should you deal with it? Don't worry — we've got you covered!
We've increased the chance of evolution element skills showing up if you already have its partner. For example, if you possess the Powerful Swing skill, your chance to get the Destructive Strike 1 will be much higher. Please note that this change will only affect 1st-level skills that you don't yet have!
We hope that this will make your play sessions even more enjoyable and comfortable.
 
[h2]Monsters will Use Active Skills Better[/h2]
We've fed our monsters some brain-stimulating vitamins, so they shall now behave more intelligently on the battlefield. The enemies will now use their active skills more adequately and when appropriate. If, for example, the boss is following you around and for whatever reason can't apply a skill on you, then after a few seconds they will re-think their behavior and use another ability instead.
This will make your fights more dynamic and interesting, adding even more challenge and adrenaline to every match!
 
[h2]Some Plans for the Near Future[/h2]
We have so many plans… Firstly, we're going to resume our developer diaries so that you can gradually receive all the necessary information about upcoming updates. Attentive readers may have already noticed that we're preparing an in-game chat that will be available from the City, as well as a system of in-game clans, ratings, and other leaderboards for you to place in and compete for valuable prizes!

A new location is already being actively developed, as well as — and this is largely thanks to our loyal players — a new skill and a number of novel in-game mechanics. The details are currently hidden under a veil of secrecy, but that's bound to change in the fullness of time!
Finally, another major announcement: we're preparing to launch on new platforms, so get ready to play The Braves on consoles and mobile devices!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2ba1c05deadce4858cbd98c54f59a8afe0599298.png[/img]
We have also prepared a Mysterious code for you in honor of the update: [u][b]spookyhalloween[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5101f48e75b9fb0a5d5532d682130083878a07e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2ba1c05deadce4858cbd98c54f59a8afe0599298.png[/img]
That's all for now, Brave Ones. The "creepy" month of October is drawing to a close, but the celebration of All Saints' Eve is in full swing! Stay tuned and share your impressions of the game in its present state — we're always happy to read your feedback, as it helps us make our title even better!

notes.notes:
Brave Ones!

We are back to tell you all about the recent additions to the game! What awaits you in the current update?

[h2]New Portals Opening[/h2]

Summer is coming to an end, but the ether currents are still filled with red-hot wind and burning sand... Behold [u][b]the Portals of the Scorching Sun and Desert Treasures![/b][/u]

Three new, unique heroes await you in the Portal of the Scorching Sun. It is time you finally meet them:

[h3]Bastet [/h3]

Legendary Heroine. Filled with ancient wisdom and piety, Bastet is ready to stand up for the innocent souls of Singor and locate the source of evil that has poisoned these lands. What does this cute-looking feline hold in her arsenal?

[list][*][b]Legendary rarity[/b][list]

[*] The Wisdom of the Desert. Bastet possesses vast knowledge of long-forgotten ancient peoples, allowing her to learn an extra passive skill.
[*] Perfect Calculations. Bastet knows how to make the most of every shot. When the number of projectiles launched with any skill reaches 3, all subsequent projectiles will deal 30% more damage upon every activation. For example, if Bastet launches 5 fireballs, the first 2 will deal normal damage with each activation, while fireballs 3, 4, and 5 will deal additional damage.
[*] +35% damage dealt with the Thread of Life skill and its evolution
[*] -7% damage dealt with other skills
[*] -15% skill cooldown
[*] +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level [/list][/list]

[list][*] [b]Mythical rarity[/b][/list][list][list]

[*] The Fury of the Desert. The desert can be a treacherous place, but Bastet is not: she is used to shining her light upon the poor and taking up arms to protect the defenseless… And yet, woe be to those who provoke her wrath. Bastet's Mythical Rarity variation has a chance to learn an extra active skill.
[*] +2 Thread of Life skill levels at the start of the match
[/list][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/f6f3ee891e60f00210fa3dff5a6b8faf80de9e1b.png[/img]

[h3]Sobek[/h3]

Legendary Hero. You always know when Sobek is nearby due to his dark aura of pain and misery. After fighting and devouring darkness for centuries, Sobek's heart had eventually hardened, and the sinister arts he swore to ward off began to take hold of him. What can this Legendary Hero do?

[list][*] [b]Legendary rarity[/b][/list][list][list]

[*] Sobek's Rage. Upon receiving damage for the first time in a fight, Sobek falls into a rage, barely able to contain the malevolent power within. A destructive aura spreads, causing damage to anyone who would dare approach him.
[*] Thorns of Darkness. After receiving damage, Sobek has a chance to summon Thorns of Darkness in a large radius around him. These will deal damage to the hero's enemies, while also slowing down their movement speed and attack rate. This skill can activate once every 15 seconds.
[*] +35% damage dealt with the Thread of Fate skill and its evolution
[*] -7% damage to other skills
[*] -50% cooldown time for the Thread of Fate skill, but note that cooldown time will increase by 5% for every 2 levels, up to level 10, at which point the cooldown bonus will be reduced to just -25%.
[*] 50% larger Thread of Fate skill's area of effect
[*] +1 Avatar of Darkness level at the start of the match
[*] +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level

[/list][/list][list][*] [b]Mythical rarity[/b][/list][list]
[list][*] +2 Thread of Fate skill levels at the start of the match
[*] The Blessing of Light and Darkness. X5 bonus towards the success rate of activating the Thread of Fate and Thread of Life skills whenever you gain a level during the current match.
[/list][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/34c598145eb79a9858ba9991c0fbad3c74323075.png[/img]

[h3]Kashta[/h3] 

Epic Hero. Do you know the saying "one-man army"? Whoever coined it has probably met Kashta. Legends have it that this warrior crossed the desert and seized the royal throne all by himself. Sounds promising, does it not? Let us see what this hero can do!

[list][*] [b]Epic rarity[/b][/list][list][list][*] The Falcon of the Desert. Kashta knows when it is better to fight the enemy head on or outflank them. Upon taking damage, he gains a 75% speed boost that is then decreased by 15% every second. This skill can activate once every 15 seconds.

The folk wisdom holds that a person's life is a canvas, with their every action woven onto it, creating an intricate pattern where it intersects the lifelines of others. It is also rumored that the sages of an ancient kingdom have learned to control these threads, and that their domain now lies in ruin as the result—swept away by the Sand Dunes, with evil abominations stalking through what were once prosperous cities... But who knows how much truth there is to these old tales? You should take them with a grain of salt. What we do know for sure is that Academy scientists have recently discovered two hitherto unseen skills and their evolutions. Judging by the ancient scrolls, we are dealing with:

[h3][b]The Thread of Life[/b][/h3]
Type: Offensive Skill. Element: Holy. When activated, horizontal stands of pure light stretch across the entire battlefield. Their divine power is so strong that any opponent that touches them will receive a lot of damage.

New skills work best with new weapons, right? And new weapons have already arrived in abundance to all the evil bosses of Singoru and, of course, to the Portal of the Eternal Soul, the Portal of the Scorching Sun, and the Portal of the Desert Treasures. Here, take a look:

[list]
[*] +25% damage dealt with the Thread of Life on Unusual Rarity
[*] +4% damage dealt with all skills on rare rarity
[*] +1 Thread of Life skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity
[*] +6% damage dealt with all skills on Legendary Rarity
[*] +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level on Mythical Rarity

[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/923140f4f8ba4cbdc8b13b034cc54436da5496d8.png[/img]

[h2]New achievements[/h2]
New heroes come with new achievements! Unlock them all and become the true savior of Singoru!

Also hurry up to enter the mystic code with nice gifts, in honor of the update: [b]SANDSOFTIME[/b].
Hurry up, because the promo code is active until 01.09.24

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca6ed5eecf6cb219a48414d868e1190854b9e35e.png[/img]
That is it for now, Brave Ones! A big update is coming soon, with new events, hero upgrades, and much more! Stay tuned and do not forget to share your thoughts and suggestions—as always, we look forward to reading your feedback!
