And for those brave men who have reached the pinnacle of skill in normal mode, they are already waiting in Hardcore Ridge. 

[h3] New Achievements:[/h3]

Opening a new location can mean not only new adventures, but also new challenges and achievements! Test your luck and skills, try to collect them all!

[h3] New quests:[/h3]

New tasks are already ready for the Town Hall task board, both for normal and Hardcore modes. Those brave men who have already completed all the tasks before them will be able to fill their wallets with pleasant and useful rewards! 

[h3]Scrolling through task chapters in the Town Hall:[/h3]

Would you like to know what challenges await you in the future? Now this is as easy as scrolling through several chapters of tasks in advance. The game has a new feature that allows you to view not yet available chapters in the Town Hall and complete tasks in advance.

[h3]Frame Rate limit:[/h3]

You asked — we did it! In the game settings, you can now choose to limit the number of frames per second: 30, 60, 100, or no limits. Enjoy the adventure according to your own rules.

In addition, we have done everything possible to make it as comfortable as possible for you to play. Now you can collect rewards with just one click. You no longer need to collect each reward individually — this saves you time and simplifies the game process.

[h3]Updated Loading Screens:[/h3]

The best artists of Singoru (who had not yet had time to eat the terrible monsters) tirelessly painted portraits of heroes who are led into battle by Brave Men. Meet the updated loading screens and the new Braves logo. We hope that you will like them. 
Hints have also been added during loading. So you can not only enjoy new works of art, but also learn something new!

[h3]New building appearance:[/h3]

Is it a shame when you build and build, but the appearance of your buildings does not change? Stop putting up with it! We've added new building looks for level 21-25. All this is designed to make your eyes enjoy something truly new!

[h3]Disabling markers in a match:[/h3]

In the heat of battle, it can sometimes be difficult to focus because of the many markers and pointers. We understand that! Now, by clicking just one button, you can hide (and then show again) all placemarks related to points of interest and auxiliary items.

[h3]Symbol Abbreviation:[/h3]

We've all had it happen that when we looked at the amount of resources needed to reach a new Town Hall level, we couldn't tell if it was hundreds of thousands or millions. Even too lazy to count how many zeros and ones there are.
Now large numbers will be presented in a more convenient way. Instead of a lot of zeros and ones, we will see only the first few digits of the number with a postscript. For example, 100M or 10K. However, if you hover over the number you are interested in, you can still see the exact number of resources.

Also we give you a mystic code in honor of the update:  ridgewinds

Well, that's all the news for today. Wait for more updates, read our diaries and just enjoy life in Singoru. After all, you are Brave and you can do anything!

notes.title: Hotfix #1 Now Life!
notes.notes:
Brave ones!

Welcome the hotfix. Today, some technical issues that could have impacted your gameplay experience were fixed.

Here is a list of what was fixed:

[list]
[*] Optimization has been improved. Due to this, the game's performance will be significantly higher.
[*] Bugs occurring in Bran Castle have been fixed. Optimization has been improved. Now the game will be smoother and more enjoyable. The location has also been slightly decorated, so hurry up and enter the game to check out the new decor.
[*] Playing with a gamepad has become even more convenient. Now in the Forge, you only need to double-click the button to equip the desired item.
[*] You will no longer encounter errors when visiting the Tavern. The bug that caused freezes has been fixed.
[*] The bug where the Prism purchase window in the bank did not respond to clicks has been fixed.
[/list]
Thank you for your feedback, thanks to you the game is getting better and better!

notes.title: New Adventures in The Braves: Full Version Coming!
notes.notes:
Brave Ones!

Today is the day when it's time to say goodbye to The Braves: Beginning. It was closed today at 14:00 UTC, which means that the full version of The Braves will be available very soon!

The development team is grateful to all participants of the prologue for their help and is working tirelessly to ensure that on May 3rd you can put on your best gear and go into battle against bloodthirsty enemies! On that day, you will be able to immerse yourself in the full version of the game, where every brave soul will embark on an exciting adventure to free the world of The Braves from the forces of darkness.

Brave ones who took part in testing the game's prologue will receive valuable gifts in the main version after completing the training.

notes.title: Dev Diary #1: Release is Approaching!
notes.notes:
Brave Ones!

We know that many of you are curious about what our team is diligently working on, and we have decided to launch a weekly developer's diary so that the most curious among you can peek into the future!

So, what new features await you in the upcoming update?

[list]
[*] Launch of a new Asian server.

Some players from the Asian region may have encountered issues that significantly worsened the gaming experience. For their convenience, we are launching a new server that will provide excellent connection quality, minimizing or even eliminating disruptions. We want every brave one to be able to join the battle and test their skills!

[*] New building: Market.

You asked, and we obey! The long-awaited market will soon open its doors to you. Exchange weapons and equipment for heroes, as well as resources to upgrade the base. Now you will have a place to spend your gold!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/abf69594e2764f69756f03c01dd13b850f2cbb26.gif[/img]

Follow our news on Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/qMW5Buv6Sq] Discord [/url]  to find out what awaits you, first and foremost!

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Heroes of The Braves! We are excited to announce an update to the demo version of the game, which includes significant changes.

The character rarity system has been reworked. Now, there are no Uncommon rarity heroes in the game, but a Mythical rarity has been added.
The differences between heroes have become more pronounced. Each hero has unique properties that change the gameplay style.

Changelist:

[olist]
[*] Increased overall game dynamics: the speed of heroes and monsters has increased, cooldown times for abilities have been reduced, and experience is gained more quickly. 
[*] Decreased difficulty: Forest (medium), Laboratory (easy, medium), and Graveyard (easy).
[*] The names of all active abilities have been changed. Now, weapons and the abilities they grant have different names.
[*] New skill evolutions added: Great Boundary-Maker (evolution of Stone Shrapnel), Pain Compass (evolution of Destructive Strike), and Queen's Song (evolution of Throwing Disc).
[*] Fixed a bug where acquiring a skill during level up and from a chest happened simultaneously.
